neko_client.config.comment.searchBox:
Shows a search box on top of the Void Warehouse screen.
Match by name, pinyin, initials or registry id. Turning this off also stops the catalog request.
neko_client.config.comment.fillCombo:
Hold this, then click a warehouse slot to withdraw until your inventory
can hold no more. Combo = exactly one mouse button + any of Shift / Ctrl / Alt
(default: Ctrl+Alt+left click). Only these three modifiers work on the keyboard
side - Vanilla exposes only their state; binding a letter/number key marks the
combo as unusable (the join log says why). With modifiers bound, mouse button
codes tolerate a small +/-2 offset across versions/drivers - the log says when
a click matched via tolerance. A bare mouse button requires an exact code.
Empty = off.
neko_client.config.comment.openGui: Opens this mod's config screen (toggles and hotkeys live there).
